120	Blessed is the person who merits the Shechinah
121	with the ten sefirot of Beriah, clothed in the Name Havayah-Adnut, in her garments.
122	A person must know that the Shechinah has a mission: Havayah-Adnut.
123	This is a combination of Havayah and Adnut.
124	We see the yud of Havayah, the aleph of Adnut, the heh of Havayah,
125	the dalet of Adnut, the vav of Havayah, the nun of Adnut, the heh of Havayah,
126	the yud of Adnut.
127	Then you take Y-K-V-K, and aleph,
128	dalet, nun, yud, and you join them. This is a union,
129	like a man, a husband, joining with his wife. The moment
130	they are joined, a light goes on, as you see here, a light goes on,
131	when they connect the switch, and then it becomes a closed circuit,
132	and then the current flows through all these places. It is exactly the same here:
133	like turning on a switch, you connect, and then the light goes on.
134	This is what he writes here:
135	clothed in the Name Havayah-Adnut.
136	Amen, one who prepares the mare for her. It is said of her: whoever prepares,
137	makes ready, the mare. "To a mare in Pharaoh's chariots I have compared you, my beloved."
138	It is as if, this is something powerful.
139	Those who prepare the Shechinah: on the days of Shabbat and on festivals,
140	on Shabbat they shall be her garment, the garments of her kingship,
141	the ten sefirot of Beriah. This is the garment of the mare, so to speak, it gives strength
142	to the holy Shechinah, and indeed she can wear the ten classes of angels. And on weekdays
143	He gives her the garment of the angels, from the ten sefirot of Beriah downward. There is
144	weekday work and holy work. Weekday work is the work of angels. The angels
145	are external. There is not such hard work in it. It is not the work that the Holy One, blessed
146	be He, wants. The work of weekdays is very low work, whereas
147	the work on Shabbat, you will begin to appreciate, if you understand
148	these spiritual structures: Shabbat is a very great light, an enormous light.
149	Therefore the Shechinah is not present on weekdays.
150	Everything is the likeness of the Shechinah, the likeness of light.
151	On weekdays everything is the klipot, the klipot rule everything.
152	Even prayers do not ascend on weekdays.
153	The ascent of prayers happens only on Shabbat.
154	Therefore whoever...
155	only if you sanctify Shabbat properly, honor Shabbat properly.
156	You study on Shabbat.
157	There are people who honor Shabbat with sleep.
158	Sleep.
159	They sleep for hours. I say, on the contrary, be wise:
160	finally, on Shabbat, it is the sweet light, the sweet light.
161	How do you go to sleep when everyone is being given a package, each one receives one, and you go to sleep?
162	When blows are being handed out, you get up. Why do you get up?
163	On weekdays you get up, he is getting beaten, you get up instead of sleeping.
164	And the reverse, it is the reverse: on Shabbat there is no need
165	to overdo sleep and eating, pleasure and delights on Shabbat.
166	Good eating, tasty eating, beautiful clothing, enjoyable reading, good
167	prayers. You see how, you will know: enter the synagogue for prayer, enter the house of
168	prayer, you must feel a very special light receiving you, a very beautiful light,
169	a special light, all gentleness, all delight. You feel it in your hands,
170	in your feet, you suddenly float a little. Shabbat gives you something,
171	a special delight. And then, where is the strongest aspect of Shabbat?
172	When you open to study while everyone is sleeping, you get up to study, you open,
173	you see how the light flows so easily, everything flows, everything goes in,
174	without questions, without anything, without a thing. This is the wisdom: wisdom to know how to use Shabbat.
175	Therefore he writes here: on the days of Shabbat and festivals they shall be her garments, the garments
176	of her kingship, which are the ten sefirot of Beriah, and on weekdays, the ten classes of angels,
177	which are from the ten sefirot of Beriah downward. There the angels are
178	found, in Beriah, throughout the weekdays. On Shabbat it is
179	the world of souls, the ten sefirot of Atzilut. The queen, on that day, the ten sefirot
180	of Atzilut are the king. They descend there and become the inner essence
181	of the world of Beriah. Atzilut becomes the essence of Beriah, and Beriah clothes them, and they become
182	one on that day. And then Atzilut is the aspect of one, of unity.
183	Gentlemen, lately I have been making an effort to explain what unity is. I am making a great effort
184	to explain what is called "one."
185	I do not think it is easy.
186	What do you think?
187	One?
188	This is one.
189	What do you mean?
190	It is not one, it is millions of things.
191	It is not one.
192	To find what one is.
193	There is no example of one in creation.
194	It is possible.
195	We have to build the system of the One over years to understand what one is.
196	Yes.
197	It seems to me, as Rabbi Nachman said, a change in form.
198	Sameness?
199	Yes, change.
200	Sameness.
201	There are many other things that explain what one is.
202	According to Kabbalah, as the Ari explains, echad is ach plus dalet: we join the ach with the dalet.
203	Brother and sister are separate on weekdays, they are apart.
204	This is a sister and this is a brother.
205	And now we join them. When we join the ach to the dalet, the two brothers, we join them, then
206	we get one.
207	This is a secret.
208	"My sister, my beloved, my dove, my perfect one."
209	The sister became his wife, and his wife has to resemble him in one form, and then
210	it is called one: when the female and the male unite, they unite, then it is called one. This is
211	called union, and according to Kabbalah this is called the union of the zivug, that they become one. This is
212	called, as if there is no male: wherever you turn, you see a male, the same
213	thing. This way you see, this is male, this is female, in unity, wherever you turn
214	it is the same. This is called one. But this is Kabbalah, it has to be explained through deep study what
215	unity is according to Kabbalah. Believe me, according to Kabbalah one can explain unity, but
216	according to the simple meaning it is very, very, very hard. And the Cause of all is illuminated in the ten sefirot
217	of Atzilut, and in the ten sefirot of Beriah, and illuminated in the ten classes, and he expands. What do we have? Note
218	we have ten sefirot of Atzilut, you hear, Gilad, ten sefirot of Beriah,
219	ten classes of angels, angels, and ten spheres.
220	And these are four levels: there is Atzilut, which is souls, afterwards
221	the ten of Beriah, which is angels, afterwards you have spheres,
222	afterwards you have firmaments. So these are four worlds:
223	Atzilut, Beriah, Yetzirah, Asiyah. It is a secret, as if the Rabbi is now speaking about the four
224	garments we mentioned: Y-K-V-K and aleph, dalet, nun, yud. These four
225	things. Now they ask, they say: Yechezkel,
226	the prophet, is the only one, the only one, Yechezkel the prophet, who succeeded in seeing something close to us,
227	the spiritual. They say to him: "Arise, Yechezkel,"
228	He says: why is he called Yechezkel? Because he was weak, he was
229	weak, he needed to be strengthened, because he saw something. Many people
230	become weak when they see something spiritual, they see something spiritual and do not understand it,
231	they see something spiritual and do not understand, and they become very weak, they have no
232	strength. Even Avraham Avinu would fall at first. Avraham Avinu
233	would see visions of Elokim and fall, so it is written, he could not hold
234	up.
235	The same with Eliyahu, and Yechezkel the prophet too: he saw visions of Elokim and did not
236	understand it.
237	So he asked HaShem to strengthen him, to understand these things.
238	Therefore he is called Yechezkel.
239	"Arise, Yechezkel the prophet," the visions of the Shechinah are revealed to us.
